title: fix(ui): show visible shimmer while the dashboard loads
body:
Related: #151513 (startup visibility only; this does not complete the broader shimmer consolidation).

## What Problem This Solves

The dashboard's initial loading placeholders can look frozen because several themes give the shimmer highlight and placeholder fill the same color.

## User Impact

Startup and route-loading placeholders now show a gentle, visible two-second sweep in light and dark themes. Layout and loading timing stay unchanged, and reduced-motion users retain static placeholders. No configuration changes, dependencies, or migration are required.

## Why This Change Was Made

The screenshot's owner is the initial connection splash, not the static preboot fallback or chat-panel skeleton. This uses the existing transform-only skeleton animation with a translucent text-color highlight scoped to the shared startup/loading surface. Other skeleton consumers are unchanged.

## Worked on by

- @vincentkoc

## Work sessions

- [Original discussion with @vincentkoc](https://team.openclaw.ai/chat/roboclaw/dashboard/5ee3e329-3064-4e62-8548-2bd624ad1f68)
- [Implementation and verification](https://team.openclaw.ai/chat/roboclaw/dashboard/294c4705-ac67-4fd4-933a-0e17aff034a3)

## Evidence

- The real initial-connect pixel regression fails before the fix (zero RGB change) and passes afterward. It also verifies that reduced motion has no active sweep.
- Complete owning initial-connect E2E file: 13/13 passing, 29.53 seconds wall with one worker; the changed scenario took 2.40 seconds locally and 2.856 seconds in hosted CI. This extends the existing app-boot fixture instead of adding another suite or server boot.
- Actual UI browser matrix: 11 theme families × light/dark × desktop/mobile (1280×900 and 390×844), with normal and reduced motion. Every combination showed visible motion, unchanged geometry, no horizontal overflow, and static reduced-motion placeholders.
- Focused Stylelint, Oxlint, formatting, and git diff checks pass. Independent review found no actionable P0–P2 findings.
- Browser proof used the actual source UI with a deferred mocked Gateway connection in a network-isolated, secretless Chromium container; no production Gateway was changed. Broad local build/typecheck suites were not run for this narrow CSS repair. [Exact-head hosted CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36129032074) passed for f659897dc563b95ec258dc78835ae9d741368e5f, including all nine UI E2E shards, UI checks, startup corpus, performance, and applicable type/lint/dependency/architecture guards.

Actual Control UI, Rosé dark, 1280×900; pending mocked Gateway connection. Screenshots use the same midpoint of the existing sweep.
